questions.q: What bargaining is going on at Mrs Lithebe's when Kumalo returns from Ezenzeleni?
choices: Buying a stove for his wife
Mrs Lithebe has found a buyer for Gertrude's table, chairs and pots and pans — sold for three pounds
questions.explain: The aluminium pots, which black people do not usually buy, were 'the gift of a friend' — Kumalo does not inquire further.

questions.q: How does Kumalo know, before a word is spoken, that Msimangu and the young white man bring bad news?
choices: By their set faces and the low tones in which they speak
They arrive in a police car
questions.explain: 'With the habit born of experience, he forced himself to go to the gate.'

questions.q: What does the young white man tell Kumalo in the room?
choices: That Absalom has been found alive and well
'I have heard what you fear. It is true.' — Absalom is arrested
That the search is over and hopeless
That the reformatory will take Absalom back
questions.explain: They speak 'as one talks in a room where someone is dead.'

questions.q: Who is 'one of the two others' arrested with Absalom?
choices: Matthew Kumalo, the son of Kumalo's brother John
questions.explain: The third is Johannes Pafuri; 'it was he [Absalom] who fired the shot.'

questions.q: How does Kumalo physically respond to the news, again and again?
choices: He nods his head, 'not once, nor twice, but three or four times'
questions.explain: The old man's nodding becomes a haunting image of his shock and grief.

questions.q: What does Kumalo decide to do first, before going to the prison?
choices: Go and tell his brother John
questions.explain: 'My brother first, he said, if you will show me the way only.'

questions.q: How does John Kumalo react once he grasps that his own son was there too?
choices: Fear comes into his eyes; he says 'Who will believe your son?' — planning to deny that Matthew and the third man were present
He goes at once to the police
questions.explain: The young white man tells John, 'thank God you are not my brother.'

questions.q: How does the young white man describe his own work, in his angry speech?
choices: 'It is my work to reform, to help, to uplift... You save souls, but I save souls also'
'The Church should do it, not me.'
questions.explain: 'I saw this Absalom born into a new world and now I shall see him go out.'

questions.q: In the first prison visit, how does Absalom answer his father's questions about why he did it?
choices: With almost nothing — 'I do not know', 'It is as my father says', 'It was bad companions', 'It was the devil'
By refusing to speak at all
questions.explain: 'He is a stranger, he said, I cannot touch him, I cannot reach him.'

questions.q: Why does Absalom say he was carrying a loaded revolver?
choices: 'For safety' — Johannesburg is a dangerous place, 'A man never knows when he will be attacked'
Someone gave it to him as a gift
questions.explain: He also says he still wishes to marry the girl.
